An '''EV-series supervisor droid''' working with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] operated on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The droid fought [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], flying a heavily-armed [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]].
